[SWS_CM_10099]
⌈
The element is serialized depending on the type in the type field.
This also defines the length of the data. All bytes behind the data that are covered by
the length, are padding. The deserializer shall skip the padding bytes by calculating
the required number according to the formula given in [SWS_CM_10088].
⌋
